title: Require affects_skills and affects_specs on every cell
action: Per D3 (the plan records predicted affected skills/specs per cell) and the plan's discretion value: every cell carries two flat arrays, `affects_skills` and `affects_specs` (repo-relative paths; an empty array means 'none'), required on `cells add` for EVERY lane. Anchors (rg -n in src/verbs/cells/validate.rs): line 265 `for key in ["deps", "decisions", "files", "read_first"] {` is the array-shape loop — add the two keys to the same shape check, and add a presence check beside line 301 `match cell.get("files") {` that refuses a missing key by name with a FIX line naming both keys and the `[]` spelling. `cells update` keeps accepting the keys without requiring them (existing cells predate the field). Update the `cells add` help text in src/generated/registry_payload.json (rg -n '"cells add"' there) and the catalog counts in src/catalog.rs if the registry drift test moves. Sync the home spec docs/knowledge/areas/workflow-state/cells-authoring-and-revision.md (cell field table) and the planning skill's cell quality rules at skills/bee-planning/references/planning-reference.md:112 `## Cell quality rules` + the example JSON at `## Example cell JSON` — then run the regen chain (`bee dev regen`) because skills/ is a release-manifest root. Tests: add refuses a cell missing either key (names the key); add accepts `[]`; update without the keys still succeeds; cite the existing add-validation cases in src/verbs/cells/tests.rs (rg -n 'fn add_cell' there) as the fixture pattern.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee cells && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test registry_contracts && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check
